implication: Regulation 10(6) exemptions typically cover acquisitions by promoters, existing shareholders or other specified categories where the acquirer is exempt from the general requirement to make an open offer; this filing flags a structured acquisition rather than a market-triggered mandatory bid situation.

headline: Sachin D. Patel acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Exemption
sum: Sachin D. Patel filed a formal disclosure with NSE under Regulation 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 in respect of an acquisition relying on an exemption. The filing documents an acquisition made in reliance upon the exemption provided under Regulation 10 of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011.
detail: The disclosure was submitted by Sachin D. Patel to NSE under the SEBI takeover code. The filing references Regulation 10(6) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, which provides exemptions from the requirement to make a public offer to shareholders in certain specified circumstances. The exact value, number of shares acquired, and prior and post-acquisition holding percentages are not disclosed in the excerpt provided. This is a formal regulatory filing category required whenever a party acquires shares in reliance on a specific SEBI exemption.
